voice.name: Open Sector - Fw 190
voice.description: Male ace fighter pilot in his early thirties, ice-cool and effortlessly smooth over the cockpit radio, relaxed low baritone with a hint of a continental European accent, laconic and a little arrogant, never raises his voice, sounds like he is smiling behind his oxygen mask.
voice.sample: Relax, I have the bandit. Rolling in from the sun, he never sees me. Two short bursts and he is finished. Back home in time for coffee. Nobody out-turns me up here, nobody.

ready: Fw 190, airborne and bored. Find me someone.
die: Going in. Tell them I was fast.

fire.prompt: Aircraft 30mm cannon strafing burst, heavy rapid thudding autocannon fire from a fighter plane with shell impacts, outdoors medium distance, no music, no voice

move.prompt: WWII radial-engine fighter plane accelerating and flying past fast overhead, loud powerful engine roar with doppler shift, outdoors, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Fighter plane shot down, engine sputtering and screaming as it dives, crash impact and explosion with scattering metal debris, outdoors, no music, no voice
